A '''vrelt''' was a small rodent native to the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] and considered a pest. Some of the more superstitious folks (including [[Spacer/ would gnaw at their extremities and faces if not driven away. [[Danalis]] had her nose and ears chewed off by vrelts before being "rescued" by [[Garris Shrike]].
Legends|spacers]]) considered them to be bad omens, and the term was often used in a derogatory sense. Vrelts were a danger to street dwellers because they
When used to describe a sentient, the term was derogatory.
